description: Header file defining the ChunkedUploadDataStream class and its nested Writer class, which facilitate push-based data uploading with buffering behavior, including methods for creating writers, appending data, and internal stream management.

classes.name: ChunkedUploadDataStream
classes.description: A push-based upload data stream that buffers all data until completion, supporting multiple writers and stream management.

classes.name: ChunkedUploadDataStream::Writer
classes.description: Utility class for writing data to a ChunkedUploadDataStream, safe to outlive the stream and used on the stream's thread.

methods.name: CreateWriter
methods.description: Creates a writer object for appending data to the stream.

methods.name: AppendData
methods.description: Appends data to the stream, with an indication if this is the last chunk.

methods.name: ChunkedUploadDataStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream with an identifier and optional null source.
